actualNativePerformance.scope: 108 native idle/dense/stopped windows: actual discovery, owned/native playing source counts, real decoder-worker completions, process/audio-thread CPU, Java allocations and packet/socket traffic. Tables retain per-target and per-window observations.
limitations: Actual hidden native clients and real paid loaded sources; no synthetic sink or injected source state.
OpenAL channel.playing verifies native state, not human audibility, perceived mix, seamlessness or HUD legibility.
Whole-process CPU includes rendering, gameplay, networking, JVM/GC and native audio threads. It is not isolated audio CPU or foreground GPU acceptance.
Sound-engine Java-thread CPU is measured; Java MXBean cannot separately attribute native OpenAL mixer-thread CPU. Process CPU includes those native threads.
Thread allocation is Java heap only, excluding native/direct buffers. Surviving-thread totals explicitly report thread churn.
Windows thread CPU counters are quantized; a zero short-region CPU delta does not mean zero work. Prefer tick wall/heap and whole-window CPU comparisons.
Per-tick AudioRuntime measurements include its bounded discovery; packet-triggered callbacks outside that tick are counted, not individually timed.
Cumulative decoder-worker observations include setup/prior gameplay; measured-window decode deltas distinguish cached steady loops from cold decoding.
Idle-loaded is a real game world, potentially including residual native dropped items; process totals include that world overhead.
Same host, fixed hidden-window settings and two simultaneous clients; broader hardware, drivers, latency/loss and soak coverage remain separate.
p95 ranges below are ranges of independently measured window percentiles, not a pooled sample percentile.
Each range spans independently measured windows; client ranges span both current clients. Percentiles are never pooled.
Server traffic covers both clients. Server and client windows are independently bounded and must not be subtracted as exact matching intervals.
Encoded payload bytes precede compression/framing. Socket bytes include framing but exclude TCP/IP headers.
Decoder cumulative totals are taken once from each current client process after its final window, never summed over cumulative observations; in full gameplay B is the reconnected process.
The cumulative decoder totals include real cold/setup/prior-gameplay work; they are not steady-window decode costs.
Allocation GB and MB below are decimal Java allocated bytes, not retained heap or native/direct allocations.
Allsix timings use the same guarded CPU/memory/priority profile. Same-host results are not unconstrained desktop or broadhardware benchmark measurements.
Native process CPU includes OpenAL mixing, but native mixer CPU and native/direct allocations are not isolated. Java allocated bytes are not retained/peak process memory.
Guard job peak committed memory is separately measured and cannotbe substituted for per-window Java allocation.
No hearing, perceived loop/mix, HUD legibility or provenance/rights approval inferred. Human checks remain pending.
Previous failed, interrupted, profiled and superseded-package receipts retain their original status and are excluded from these six accepted sessions.
